verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly documents a first-party "Change history" feature for releases and flags, which is the audit-log surface this story asks for. A community user also notes the Slack integration gives visibility into flag changes, which corroborates that changes are tracked. The evidence is mostly page titles, so the specific fields the story requires are only implied. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that each entry records the actor, timestamp, and before/after values; retention and export details for the audit log; independent hands-on corroboration of change-history completeness.
